verses.text: Mamin Jehová, schaokab' a k'ol ab'an tas swala', yujto ilb'aj in k'o'ol, te malaj pax wip swab'i.
Kolineli, yujto k'anab'ajum in t'ayach. Mamin, kolin a in a chekab' in tik, yujto a ach tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' a k'o'ol t'ayin. Masanil k'u swal in b'a t'ayach.
Mamin, ak' tzalajb'ok in k'ol a in a chekab' in tik, yujto a t'ayach tzin lesalwi.
Mamin, te wach' ach, ak'um ach lajwok chukal. Te niwan a wach'k'olal aykot t'a yib'anh heb' syal sb'a t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal, maklej ab' tas tzin k'an t'ayach.
Ayik ayin och t'a sya'elal swal in b'a t'ayach, yujto tzach tak'witaxon t'a in lesal.
Mamin Kajalil, malaj junokxo Dios icha wal ach tik. Mamin, malaj junok mach syal sb'o'an icha tas tza b'o tik.
Mamin, a ach ix a b'o masanil niwak chonhab'. Ol ja heb' yak'em sb'a t'ayach, ol yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach,
yujto a achnhej wal Dios ach. Niwan elk'ochi, satub'tak tas tza k'ulej.
Mamin Jehová, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin yik wach' tzin b'eyb'alej tas tza nib'ej t'a smasanil in k'o'ol. Ak' stek'anil in pensar tik yik wach' na'anachnhej wu'uj.
Ach Wajalil, ach in Diosal, ol walnhej wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a smasanil in k'o'ol. Ol ach wik'nhejcha'anh t'a masanil tiempo.
Yelxo wal te niwan a wach'k'olal t'ayin. Maj in a chab'atlaj t'a yet'tal heb' chamnak.
Ach in Diosal, jun wal b'ulanh heb' ak'umtak skot t'ayin. Malaj jab'ok yok'elk'olal heb', snib'ej heb' in smilanchamok. Malaj elk'och t'a sat heb'.
Ha ach xo tik ach Dios Wajalil, te ay a wach'k'olal, te ay ok'elk'olal. Manh k'unok skot yowal a k'o'ol, tzak'elk'och tas tzala'.
Ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayin, ilinkoti. Ak' wal wip, tzin a kolanel a in a chekab' in tik.
Ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin t'a sjichanil, yik a ol yilan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol k'ixwok heb', yujto a ach Jehová ach tzach kolwaj wet'ok, tzak'an sniwanil in k'o'ol.
